sensitive.dialogue.chat: I'm glad you came to talk. Truly. Sit — and don't rush whatever it is.
sensitive.dialogue.chat/1: I'm so glad you came. Sit — take your time with whatever it is.
sensitive.dialogue.chat/2: Talk to me. I've a soft ear and no clock, %1$s.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations: Of course we can talk. You look like you're carrying something too — we'll trade. What's on your mind?
sensitive.dialogue.conversations/1: Yes, let's talk. Come sit — you carry things quietly, I've noticed. So do I.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations/2: Always. Whatever it is, I'll hold it gently, %1$s. Go on.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.checkin: Truly good, for once. The bread came out right and the sunrise nearly made me cry. But how are YOU, really?
Softly good. The kind of day that could bring a tear if you let it. And you? Truly?
Good, and a little tender about it. Joy hits me square in the chest. But how are you?
Heavy, honestly. And you asking just now — sorry, give me a moment. That meant something, %1$s.
Heavy. I feel everything twice, I think. Your asking lightens it, %1$s. Genuinely.
You asked already, and it still touches me. I'm alright, truly. Are YOU, though? You keep checking on me.
Twice now — you sweet thing. Still the same, still warmed that you care enough to ask again.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.day.goo: A gentle one. Cold well water, and the baker smiled at me. I keep those. You look tired, though — are you sleeping?
Gentle and kind. I collect the small mercies — a smile, cold water. You look worn, though. Rest tonight?
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.day.rou: Hard. I heard the neighbors arguing and carried it all day like it was mine. I do that. Talking helps, so thank you.
I took on the whole village's weather today. I do that. Talking it out helps — thank you for staying.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.work.li: I do. You can pour a whole mood into your hands and the work just... holds it for you. Does yours do that?
I do. The work takes whatever mood I hand it and just... holds it. That's a quiet mercy.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.work.ha: Between us... it wears on me. Not the labor — the way nobody asks how it's going. You just did, though. I noticed.
Not the labor — the loneliness of it. Nobody asks how the day's going. You did. I won't forget it.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.village: %2$s holds a lot of quiet hearts, %1$s. I try to notice the ones that need noticing. It's home because of them.
I love %2$s the way you love people — for the cracks as much as anything. Every worn doorstep has a story.
Good souls, all carrying something. I feel it when one of them is struggling, even across the square. I bring bread.
They're precious to me, honestly. I know who hasn't smiled this week, and I make it my business to fix it.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.food.fi: Something shared, at a warm table. Food's love made edible, %1$s — that's not just a saying to me.
The inn's stew when the whole family's there. It's never really about the food. It's the faces around it.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.life.fi: No one's asked so gently before. It's an ordinary story — but there's a winter in it my eyes still sting over. Sit close.
You asked so kindly. It's an ordinary tale with one winter I still cry over. Sit close, I'll trust you with it.
A house where nobody leaves the table angry. That's it, that's the whole dream. Small, isn't it? It doesn't feel small.
A table nobody leaves angry from. That's all. It sounds small and it isn't, %1$s.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.fears.f: That someone I love will be hurting right in front of me and I'll miss it. I check faces the way the guard checks the wall.
Missing someone's pain when it's right in front of me. I read faces all day for the signs.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.feeling: You listen with your whole face, %1$s. Do you know how rare that is? Around you I don't have to be the strong one.
With you I get to set the weight down. You've no idea what that's worth to someone like me.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.deflect: You're kind to ask — I felt that. But that story still bruises, and I'd want to trust the hands I put it in. Give us time?
You asked so gently — I felt it. But that story still bruises. Let me learn to trust the hands first?
Gently, %1$s... not yet. That answer lives somewhere very soft. Keep being how you are, and one day it walks out on its own.
Not yet, %1$s. That one lives somewhere very tender. Keep being kind, and it'll come out on its own.
Nothing spoken, anyway. But the mason's been quieter than usual and I don't like it. I'll bring him bread. That's the news.
Nothing spoken. But the mason's gone quiet, and quiet worries me. I'll bring bread. That's my kind of news.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.us.happ: Happy? You let me be soft without flinching, %1$s. Do you know how safe that feels? Yes. Endlessly yes.
With you the tears are mostly the good kind now. That's everything to me. Yes, love.
%2$s and %3$s were married, %1$s — I cried through the whole thing. Two hearts choosing each other out loud... it undoes me every time.
Oh, %2$s and %3$s wed! I'm still dabbing my eyes. When they looked at each other I felt it right in my chest. Weddings ruin me, gladly.
%2$s and %3$s have parted, and my heart aches for them both — there's no villain in a thing like that, just two people hurting. I've brought them each some bread.
%2$s and %3$s split, and I've felt it all week. Love ending is its own kind of grief, %1$s. I just want to sit with them both.
We lost %2$s. I've cried more than I'd admit — some souls leave a room so much emptier. Come here, %1$s. Grief's lighter shared.
%2$s passed, and my heart hasn't stopped aching. They mattered so much more than words can hold. I'll carry them a long while.
%2$s was born! Oh, I wept the happy kind of tears — a brand-new heartbeat in the village. Nothing on this earth moves me like it.
There's a new baby, %2$s, and I'm just overflowing, %1$s. Those tiny fingers... I can't. Pure joy, right through me.
%2$s moved in, and I've already decided to love them. A new soul among us — I want them to feel held from the very first day.
Someone new — %2$s — has come to stay. My heart just opens for the newly-arrived. I brought them soup and probably cried on the doorstep.
%2$s left us for good, and I felt every step of that goodbye. Partings tear at me, %1$s. I already miss the sound of their door.
%2$s has gone away. I stood waving until they were out of sight, tears and all. The village keeps a little emptier now, right here in my chest.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.confused: Oh — I'm sorry, I didn't quite understand. Could you say it again?
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: I want to get this right… one more time, gently?
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.hint: Maybe… ask me about %2$s? I'd like that.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: We could talk about %2$s, if that feels right.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: I'm sorry… I truly don't know.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: *worries at a sleeve* I wish I had an answer.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: Did you mean %2$s… or %3$s? I don't want to answer the wrong one.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.dropped: Of course. We can leave it right there.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/1: That's alright. Some things need to rest.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.busy: Oh — just a moment, please? I don't want to give you half my attention.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: One second, I promise. Then I'm all yours.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.muted: I understand. I'll be here, quietly.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Alright… I hope I didn't overdo it, %1$s.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Goodbye… thank you for stopping. It meant something.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.insult: Oh… that hurt more than you probably meant it to.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.hail: Oh, %1$s… it does my heart good to see you.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Hello, %1$s. I was hoping the day would bring you by.
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold/1: Mm. *hugs their basket a little closer*
sensitive.dialogue.chatmode.attentive: Yes? I'm here, %1$s. Whatever it is.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.day.rou: It is. And you didn't tell me it could be worse, which people always do, and it never helps.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.checkin: The wood. Tuesday. ...You meant it. I checked your face. You meant it.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.work.fo: ...It is. I didn't think anyone could tell. I've been trying quite hard for nobody to tell.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.fears.o: You'll stand with me. ...Give me a moment. That landed harder than I was ready for.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.hopes.r: You waited for me. I could feel you waiting and it was the opposite of pressure, somehow.
sensitive.dialogue.conversations.life.re: You asked about my life once and I've thought about it every night since. Is that strange?
